profile_text.body:
Cadence Design Systems Inc describes itself as a leading EDA and Intelligent System Design provider delivering hardware, software, and IP for electronic design. Its website also highlights company culture, recognition on Fortune's 100 Great Places to Work, and investment in sustainability.

Public records identify the company as a for-profit public company headquartered in San Jose, California, trading under the ticker CDNS, with SEC CIK number 0000813672. Public records list 281 legal matters in California involving the company. The available data does not list specific products or MCP servers.
